name: smart-app-banner
title: Smart app banner
description: A smart banner for phones that points to your store app: icon, name, rating, one Get or Open button and a close, left to you.
docs: Give it the name, a pitch, the icon (or let it draw a monogram of the name), the rating with its count, and storeHref. When you know the app is installed, pass installed and openHref, a deep link such as atlas://home: the button then reads Open. onAction tells you which button was followed, and onDismiss is where you store the choice and keep the banner away for thirty days; the banner hides itself when it is closed. showOn is "phones" by default (below 640px), "tablets" (below 1024px) or "all", and position says which page edge it sits on, "top" or "bottom": it picks the border side and pads the banner for the notch or the home indicator when the page sets viewport-fit=cover, while you place the banner in your layout yourself. The rating is stars and words, "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from 12,400 reviews", with the numbers formatted for locale. This is for an app in a store; installing a web app is a different prompt. labels translates the fixed words.
